description:
Retire the `cli_query_graph` suite's copy of the issue-construction fixture.

## Background

Shared test support (`crate::test_utils`) defines `fixture_issue(title, description)`, which drafts an issue and assigns it a random UUID. Copies with the same body still exist. `crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph/main.rs` defines its own copy, which the suite's modules call.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `cli_query_graph/main.rs` defines no issue-construction fixture, and the suite calls the shared one.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each test asserts what it asserted before.
title: cli_query_graph uses the shared issue fixture
